title: The Terms and Community Guidelines promise a report review as soon as we can, matching the report form

source.ref: Help center audit 2026-11-18; owner ruling 2026-11-19 "Soften to match"

detail:
The report form was softened to "as soon as we can" on 2026-11-18 (LIVE-2389), which left the Terms and the Community Guidelines promising a review "within 24 hours". Three surfaces made two different promises. The owner ruled on 2026-11-19 to soften the two pages to match.

DONE 2026-11-19: app/terms/page.tsx and app/guidelines/page.tsx say "as soon as we can". The zero-tolerance clause, the removal and suspension language and the report and block paths are unchanged (LIVE-723).

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
